evidence_quote: The reasons of low interest of Russian enterprises in applying the energy management system are analyzed in this article.

Thereupon, the article examines a variation of the in-house energy management system implementation and proposes an algorithm concerning the method preparation necessary for energy management system formation.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper analyses EnMS certification and implementation barriers and proposes methodical support, but does not identify or characterise an EnPI or EnB measurement model.
